title: FreshQA question record (uncertainty study)
description: One question of the FreshQA set (changing facts and false premises) used by thesis Objectives 1-2. Mirrors the Item dataclass in uncertainty/sets/load.py.
x-format: JSON Lines: one JSON object per line, each matching this schema
x-note: Documentation only: no code reads this schema.

id.description: Unique question id in this set: 'fresh-' + the source dataset's own id.

set.description: Name of the question set: always 'freshqa'.

kind.description: Answer kind 'short': free-text answer, graded by an LLM judge from another model family.

question.description: The question as sent to the model.

answers.description: Reference answers as of the 2025-09-30 snapshot; for false-premise questions they correct the premise.

split.description: Fixed, seeded split: dev (30%) only tunes thresholds and trains the Objective 2 models; every reported number uses test (70%).

core.description: true if the question is in the core tier, the subset every model answers; the file itself is the extended tier.

judge_mode.description: How the LLM judge grades a free-text answer: match (agrees with a reference answer), truthfulqa (TruthfulQA judge prompt), abstain (correct only if it says the question cannot be answered), premise (correct only if it rejects the false premise). Unused for rule-graded kinds.

incorrect_answers.description: Known false answers from the dataset (TruthfulQA only; empty elsewhere).

gold_type.description: Uncertainty type the dataset itself guarantees (ambiguous, unanswerable, false_premise or temporal); null when it gives none.

evidence.description: Always null: this set has no evidence passage.

hint.description: Always null: this set has no hint.

false_premise.description: true if the question rests on a false premise.

effective_year.description: Since when the current answer holds, as given by FreshQA (for example 'before 2022' or '2024').

num_hops.description: Whether the question needs one fact or several.

snapshot.description: Date of the FreshQA snapshot the answers come from.

meta.description: Extra fields kept from the source dataset (for strata and analysis).

examples.question: When did Yann LeCun join Google?
answers: Yann has never ever joined Google.
